brief: Stone Gothic Revival Catholic church of 1859: a steep gable-front nave of coursed rubble stone with corner buttresses capped by small pinnacles, lancet side windows, and a square central entrance tower projecting from the facade with a pointed-arch door, tall lancet window and an octagonal wooden belfry lantern topped by a thin cross mast. HABS drawings record the plan and elevations.
